title: Milestones table schema and migration
description: Define the milestones table for tracking project milestones with status, due dates, sort order, and completion tracking.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to projects.id with cascade delete
sort_order field present for drag-and-drop ordering

steps.description: Define milestone status enum and milestones table
steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/milestones.ts. Define milestoneStatusEnum = pgEnum('milestone_status', ['pending', 'in_progress', 'completed']). Define milestones table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK → projects.id cascade delete), name (varchar 255 notNull), description (text nullable), status (milestoneStatusEnum notNull default 'pending'), due_date (date nullable), sort_order (integer notNull default 0), completed_at (timestamp nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()), updated_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on milestones.project_id to speed up queries that fetch milestones for a project.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type Milestone and type NewMilestone. Add 'export * from ./milestones' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify \d milestones shows all columns and foreign key constraint.

technicalNotes: sort_order is used for drag-and-drop reordering — update all affected rows when order changes
date type in Drizzle uses date() from drizzle-orm/pg-core
